title: Software Engineer, New Grad
description:
Public listing summary from Stripe Careers; check the employer page for the complete, current information.

Full-time engineering role on Stripe's University team in Dublin HQ. Build financial infrastructure and learn unfamiliar systems with experienced colleagues.

Requirements
- Computer science or related bachelor's/master's degree by summer 2027, or equivalent experience. New graduates: at most 18 months of professional experience, excluding internships.
- Programming practice through coursework or personal projects; Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala and Go feature in Stripe's stack.
- Internship or team coding-project experience, independent learning and clear written communication.
- Use AI development tools while critically checking their outputs.

Preferred qualifications
- A technical speciality alongside broad skills, code review and safe production changes.
- Large-codebase experience and independent ownership of small projects.

Office attendance varies by team; confirm expectations with the hiring manager.
Official source: https://stripe.com/careers/listing/software-engineer-new-grad/8130881
